title.zh: 腾讯混元发布Hy Memory 2.0：模型、框架、应用三层全开源，开源记忆框架评测第一
title.en: 腾讯混元发布Hy Memory 2.0：模型、框架、应用三层全开源，开源记忆框架评测第一

current_state.zh: Tencent Hunyuan released Hy Memory 2.0, fully open-sourcing a dedicated memory model, the memory framework, and the MemHub local memory application that links to 10 AI tools, claiming top open-source ranking across 4 benchmarks and reporting large accuracy gains in Tencent's own products.
current_state.en: Tencent Hunyuan released Hy Memory 2.0, fully open-sourcing a dedicated memory model, the memory framework, and the MemHub local memory application that links to 10 AI tools, claiming top open-source ranking across 4 benchmarks and reporting large accuracy gains in Tencent's own products.
